summary: AECOM filed a Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing that its board declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.31 per share under its ongoing dividend program. The dividend is payable October 30, 2026 to holders of record as of October 14, 2026. No advisor, premium, or strategic transaction is referenced. Mechanics are standard: ordinary-course capital return, with future declarations subject to board discretion. This is not a special situation; watch only for dividend sustainability relative to infrastructure-services cash flow and any policy shift.
